## Use Operator Mono in VS Code

Paste this into your settings to set Operator Mono for the editor. The fallbacks are the same ones CodeFont writes.

{
  "editor.fontFamily": "'Operator Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Monaco, 'Cascadia Code', 'Roboto Mono', monospace"
}

## About the Operator Mono coding font

A classic paid programming font. Operator Mono is a paid monospace coding font without programming ligatures.

Operator Mono is not hosted on Google Fonts. The specimen above renders in the real face when the font is installed on your device; if it is not installed, the page falls back to a standard monospace face so the layout stays intact. It is one of the 95 families in the CodeFont catalog.

## Operator Mono FAQ

### Is Operator Mono free?

No. Operator Mono is a commercial font, sold by its vendor.

### Does Operator Mono support ligatures?

No. Operator Mono has no programming ligatures, so sequences such as -> and != are drawn as separate characters.

### Where can I get Operator Mono?

Operator Mono is available from Official Website. The download links are listed in the Where to get section above.
